cli=public fixture=home-fresh cmd=--help.output:
DESCRIPTION
  Portable AI coding agent config kit — SoT sync engine + helpers for Oh My Pi.

USAGE
  docks-kit <subcommand> [flags]

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)

SUBCOMMANDS
  sync         Deploy the SoT to this machine with EngineNative.
  update       Self-update the kit: autodetects the install (git checkout -> ff-only pull; bun/npm global -> @latest), then chains a flag-less sync that also refreshes plugins, even when the kit was already current (--no-sync to skip).
  toolchain    Verified-version floors for external tools (SoT/toolchain.json): check prints the doctor table; ensure installs one managed tool when it is missing; outdated compares verified pins with the newest upstream release (network, report only).
  docs         Self-documentation: the kit's concepts as readable topics, bundled with the CLI — a fresh agent can learn the kit from here alone.
  omp          Start omp with every chat-model role set to the remembered free model for this run only. The launcher starts 'omp launch' with an explicit --model, so omp reads a forwarded subcommand name as message text and a resumed session keeps the free model. It rejects forwarded flags that can select another model (--config, --model, --smol, --slow, --plan, --models, --provider, --prewalk-into, --plan-yolo-into); run omp directly for a paid model or a subcommand. The web-search role keeps the deployed provider order, which can include a paid model. No deployed configuration changes; --model or --pick remembers a new free default. Every launch checks the model against the live free catalog of each candidate profile. --fast instead toggles OpenAI/Codex fast mode in the deployed omp config and exits.
  scratch      Create an agent temporary directory, or remove agent temporary files and directories; removal accepts only paths inside the scratch root, the system temporary directory, or /var/tmp.
  tidy         List or remove safe agent leftovers (merged idle worktrees, their containers, orphaned processes in agent directories, idle scratch directories); --report lists other disk and memory use.
  plan         Plan lifecycle helper of the plan-manager skill: GitHub plan issues, plan exports and edits, and checkout snapshots.
